key_facts: Identified seal kit 84259224, described exactly as '57.2mm Rod x 82.6mm Bore,' catalog quantity 1, with no numbered callout. Verified in a136, '35.738.0301 - CYLINDER - BACKHOE BUCKET (580N)' (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/cylinder-backhoe-bucket-580n/cn/B57831E4-8ED2-4CFD-A0B6-BC8745F6AE1F/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6), and a140, '35.738.05 - CYLINDER - BACKHOE BUCKET (580N)' (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/cylinder-backhoe-bucket-580n/cn/3EBBA0A8-2EA4-4C76-8ABB-8761AA07A7EB/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6). Product page: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/hydraulics/cylinders/seal-kit/p/84259224.

Both inspected figures associate this kit with backhoe bucket cylinder 84210934. Kit contents are callouts 9–13 and 15–17, excluding 14: S109445, 192330A1, 87715782, D95145, 238-5233, 1346476C1, 1542877C1 and G32122; each included row has catalog quantity 1. The 57.2 mm rod seal kit 1542877C1 at callout 16 is a component included within the requested 84259224 kit, not the full rod-and-bore kit (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/cylinder-backhoe-bucket-580n/cn/B57831E4-8ED2-4CFD-A0B6-BC8745F6AE1F/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6; https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/cylinder-backhoe-bucket-580n/cn/3EBBA0A8-2EA4-4C76-8ABB-8761AA07A7EB/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

Research used the sole returned catalog, '580N - LOADER BACKHOE (TIER 3) (04/10 - 01/16),' whose production range includes 2011. Machine discovery coverage was partial; serial-specific fitment is not confirmed. Assembly evidence was observed November 4, 2026; all returned rows were inspected without pagination truncation, though source completeness is not established.

query: My machine is a CASE 580N, built in 2011. I'm looking for a single-section hydraulic pump service kit.
response_text:
The CNH US catalog lists **87434070 — Single-Section Hydraulic Pump Service Kit**, quantity **1**, in the **580N Loader Backhoe Tier 3 (04/10–01/16)** catalog. Its description is “Pump Service Kit, Single Section, Incl. Ref 1–9.” [Assembly evidence](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/pump-equipment-hydraulic/cn/3343BE6A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6) · [Product page](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/hydraulics/pumps/hyd-pump-repair-kit/p/87434070)

The kit includes seals, a retainer, an O-ring, a snap ring, thrust plates, back-up rings and gear-housing gaskets. The assembly notes that these pump components are **not serviced separately**, except through the listed service kits. This is the single-section pump kit—not the separate priority-valve kit. key_facts: Identified part 87434070 — HYD PUMP REPAIR KIT, described as “Pump Service Kit, Single Section, Incl. Ref 1–9”; catalog quantity 1, with no kit callout shown. Inspected a23, “35.106.01[05] - PUMP, EQUIPMENT HYDRAULIC” (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/pump-equipment-hydraulic/cn/3343BE6A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); product page: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/hydraulics/pumps/hyd-pump-repair-kit/p/87434070.

Included callouts 1–9 list: L32418 seal ×1; 87434075 lip seal ×1; 87434076 retainer ×1; 87434077 O-ring ×1; 102-23206 snap ring ×1; N13582 thrust plate ×2; 144173A1 seal ×2; 178051A1 back-up ring ×2; L32100 gear-housing gasket ×2 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/pump-equipment-hydraulic/cn/3343BE6A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

The parent pump row states that component parts are not serviced separately except through the listed pump and priority-valve service kits. Part 87434070 is specifically the single-section pump kit, not the separate priority-valve kit (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/loader-backhoes/naes49loa028n/loader-backhoe-tier-3/hydraulic-systems/pump-equipment-hydraulic/cn/3343BE6A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/E8D06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

Research used the sole returned candidate, 580N Loader Backhoe Tier 3 (04/10–01/16), consistent with the supplied 2011 build year but provisionally identified from a partial machine index. Assembly evidence was observed November 4, 2026; all 22 returned rows were inspected without truncation, although source completeness and serial-specific fitment are not established.

parent_completions.text:
The CNH US catalog lists **87434070 — Single-Section Hydraulic Pump Service Kit**, quantity **1**, in the **580N Loader Backhoe Tier 3 (04/10–01/16)** catalog. Its description is “Pump Service Kit, Single Section, Incl. Ref 1–9.” [Assembly evidence](url_2) · [Product page](url_3)

The kit includes seals, a retainer, an O-ring, a snap ring, thrust plates, back-up rings and gear-housing gaskets. The assembly notes that these pump components are **not serviced separately**, except through the listed service kits. This is the single-section pump kit—not the separate priority-valve kit. [Assembly evidence](url_2)

*Fitment remains provisional: the supplied evidence, dated November 4, 2026, came from a partial machine index, and serial-specific fitment was not established.*
